name: Audio description tracks
description: Adds a description track you already have, such as one from AudioVault, to its film or episode in Jellyfin, after checking that the lengths match.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

settings.label: Language of the description tracks
settings.hint: The track is named after it, such as English (Audio Description).

settings.label: How close the lengths must be
settings.hint: A track is added only when it is this close to the film's length. A bigger difference usually means another cut of the film.

logo.alt: A loudspeaker with a plus sign

fixed: **Jellyfin 12:** it sends Jellyfin's key the way Jellyfin 12 asks for it, so Jellyfin no longer refuses its requests where legacy authorisation is off. Older Jellyfin still works.

changed: **Lighter at rest:** it wakes about once a minute while nothing asks it anything, not twice a second.
**Starts faster:** its image comes with Python's modules already compiled, so a start takes about a quarter of the processor time.

fixed: **Its card says when it last looked:** the grey band now shows when it last looked in the folder or a track last changed. Before, it never showed a time.

added: **A logo** in Settings, Plug-ins, in the Catalogue and on its dashboard cards.
**Its card says how things are:** a status and when it last changed, in the grey band at the top of the card.
**Updates safely:** before an update it finishes adding the track it is on and starts no other.
changed: Needs Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later. A Starboard with an older plug-in API keeps version 1.0.0.

added: **Add a description track you already have:** put it in the audio-description folder in your media folder, or upload it, and it is matched to its film or episode by name
**Lengths checked:** added only when the track and the film are the same length, within the seconds you choose; otherwise it says the track is probably for another cut
**Added as an extra sound track** next to the film, named English (Audio Description), with the visual impaired flag; the film file is not changed
**Nothing deleted:** the original moves to Confirmed once you say it plays in step, and a wrong track moves to Taken off
